notes.title: Car Dealership Simulator 2 – Development Update & Release Date
notes.notes: [p][/p][h3][b]Hello everyone![/b] [/h3][p]During this intense development period, we’ve added a lot of new content to the game, expanded the map with new areas, and made the overall experience smoother, more enjoyable, and more satisfying. The long-awaited moment has finally arrived: Our game will be released on [b]September 26, 2025![/b][/p][p] [/p][p]We put great care into every vehicle in our game, working hard to perfect both the visual details and the driving dynamics. [/p][p][/p][p]Even after release, we will continue to update our game regularly with new cars, improved mechanics, and content shaped not only by our roadmap but also by player feedback.[/p][p] [/p][p]We are confident that the vehicles and gameplay will advance far beyond their current state, offering a richer experience with each passing day.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Gameplay Trailer is live![/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="vp8RJt316pI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Don’t forget to like and comment on our game trailer! You can also share your thoughts with us.[/b] [/p][p][/p][h3][b]New in-game screenshots![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/6e38cdde4ce87af60604fdca82534df851e6325b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/461c20c6985765f170934d737ef5d34434d2badf.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/820da538bd9de64ce073124319a7e96ef4412b4c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/31a47a9b60d56de2993843f44e089e2f22f1844b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/74fecf101c38ea7fdc47976be14c75148c048cec.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/1a0c763ebe4fd9d0a0802afe3bc9e9b90baa70b3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/ba854ae4db1a68bbfcf5a373834b12f11f6a1c02.jpg"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616550/Car_Dealership_Simulator_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Support the development of our game and join us on this journey — by sharing your ideas, comments, and feedback, we can take the game even further together! [/b][/p][p][b]Thank you for your support.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Car Dealership Simulator 2 Devlog Update
notes.notes: [p][/p][h3][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h3][p][b]It’s great to reconnect with you after a long break. We’ve been working hard on the game throughout the development process. During this time, we’ve added new content, expanded the map, and significantly improved the overall experience. Every detail is being carefully refined to deliver the best possible experience for our players. The release date is getting closer every day, and we’re incredibly excited, we can’t wait to share it with you very soon![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/b68060deb98cea6d4e1125f10f7ad901279cb980.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/ac5801025da8cb3d86f30c68282067bea095d42b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/992378e04d1a537e11a8edb391469b25323d23ae.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/ba854ae4db1a68bbfcf5a373834b12f11f6a1c02.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576799/2eaf05b3f352bf72a1904f922a7269b20961e67a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
